name: skill-tune
description: Measure a plugin's skill with claude plugin eval cases kept in the plugin, shorten its SKILL.md, and measure again so that no case scores lower, with the cost agreed before any run and the size capped in the plugin's test

interface.longDescription: Measures what a plugin's skill makes the agent do, shortens its SKILL.md, and shows with the same cases that no case got worse. The agent lists the parts of the SKILL.md that repeat what its scripts and files already say, agrees on cases and cuts with you, and writes claude plugin eval cases into the plugin's evals folder, each with a script that builds its starting state. A Python script copies the plugin to a private folder so your files stay unchanged while it runs, runs claude plugin eval with a cost ceiling you set, turns the results into scores per case that leave out graders that only show the skill ran, compares the old and the new SKILL.md case by case, estimates the cost from one run per case, prints the tool calls of a failing run, and lists the longest skills in a repository. Measuring needs Claude Code; in other agents the skill writes the cases and stops before measuring.
defaultPrompt: Measure this plugin's skill with evals and shorten its SKILL.md
